variants.name: brush_dense
variants.extra_prompt: Make the Korean title feel hand-drawn and premium, not like a default font. White core letters, strong cobalt blue outer energy, red slash accents, dense stacked composition, aggressive commercial webnovel cover mood.

variants.name: sharp_calligraphy
variants.extra_prompt: Use sharper calligraphic tips and more elegant stroke tapering. Keep strong readability, but push it toward high-end serialized fantasy cover typography.

variants.name: grunge_energy
variants.extra_prompt: Push rougher paint texture, imperfect edges, chromatic blue bleed, and rough red scratch marks. Keep the title exact and very readable.

variants.name: integrated_block
variants.extra_prompt: Make the title block feel structurally integrated into the image, like a designed mass that balances the heroine rather than a sticker placed on top.
